result:
This is complete and correctly scoped. Summary of what changed:

- **`crates/ucal/src/clock.rs`**: added `session_drift()`, which reads the process-wide session (anchoring it on first use, same as `session_now`), computes `Session::divergence` against a fresh system-clock read, and reports the magnitude in nanoseconds plus a direction (`ahead`/`behind`/`in step`). Added two unit tests.
- **`crates/ucal/src/lib.rs`**: `cmd_doctor_measuring` (i.e. `ucal doctor --clock`) now appends a `session_drift` subsection to `clock_measured`, gated on the `civil` feature (needed for the leap-table conversion), leaving the plain `ucal doctor` output and other feature combinations untouched.
- **`crates/ucal/tests/golden.rs`**: added a test asserting `doctor --clock` exposes `session_drift` with `drift_ns`, `system_clock`, and `note`.

Verified: `cargo test -q -p ucal --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p xtask --no-fail-fast` both pass, plus manual checks of text and `--json` output and of feature combos (`std` without `civil`, and no `alloc`, which was already broken pre-existing/unrelated). No commit was made, per your instructions.
